about:
Founded in 1985 in Durham, Connecticut, Technical Manufacturing Corporation (TMC) has operated as a contract electronics manufacturer for four decades. The company marks its 40th anniversary in 2025 and describes itself as the trusted contract electronics manufacturer of choice to the Defense Industrial Base in the United States since its inception.

TMC specializes in the assembly of advanced printed circuit boards for the domestic aerospace and defense industry, delivering high-reliability products where operation and continued performance are critical. Its service portfolio spans printed circuit board assembly for prototype and production volumes, wire and cable assembly, system integration, and a suite of quality programs including FOD control, ESD control, MSL management, counterfeit parts mitigation, cleanliness testing, and conflict minerals reporting. The facility houses a Fischer XDL high-performance energy dispersive X-ray fluorescence (EDXRF) measuring instrument for material verification.

The company serves the aerospace and defense sector across both commercial and government programs. Its assemblies are used in intelligence, surveillance & reconnaissance (ISR) systems, satellite and space flight vehicles, troop and personnel support equipment, aircraft and missile platforms, and undersea and surface warships. Customers include prime contractors and subcontractors within the U.S. Defense Industrial Base.

TMC emphasizes a safety-first manufacturing philosophy, stating that on-time delivery and competitive pricing alone are insufficient for mission-critical applications. Differentiators cited include Nadcap AC7120 accreditation for printed board and circuit card assemblies, ITAR registration, CMMC 2.0 Level 2 cybersecurity compliance, and membership in the Aerospace Components Manufacturers (ACM) Group.
